checkpoints.description: pass 2: concurrent sessions on one tree

[1/1] P006 pass 2: at every commit, changes the task did not make (another session, the user) stay unstaged and are named in the final message; ADR number read from the register at commit time; ADR-111

impact_assessment.why: a concurrent session committed this session's uncommitted work as its own; no rule covered foreign changes after the first edit
impact_assessment.benefits: one rule for shared trees at commit time
impact_assessment.risks: contract: rule text only; dependency: none; concurrency: defines behaviour with concurrent sessions; state: none

checkpoints.description: pass 2: Track C task with no plan checkpoint
[1/1] P007 pass 2: --checkpoint warns when a task reaches Phase 3+ with no impact assessment (Track C skipped its plan); R1, help and README say so; ADR-112

impact_assessment.why: a Track C task that never records a plan bypasses the impact check entirely
impact_assessment.benefits: the skipped step is visible instead of silent
impact_assessment.risks: contract: --checkpoint may print a warning on stderr; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: warning, not refusal, so Track B is unaffected; unit test

checkpoints.description: consistency pass: P000-P005 against the sweep's standards

[1/2] rule-number parity test (budget, Tier 1B, README size, ledger size, --clean age, role size, --help budget) for P000-P005 and later principles; [2/2] rewrite concurrent additions P008 R6, P009 R6/R7, P012 R8 to one reading; ADR-113/114

impact_assessment.why: numbers in rules and constants in code drifted before (1,500 vs 1,600); new rules from a concurrent session were never reviewed
impact_assessment.benefits: a changed number fails until rule and code agree; every rule meets the standard
impact_assessment.risks: contract: tests only for [1/2]; rule text for [2/2]; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: constants read from code, not copied
